title: A chunked body over its limit lost its connection before the drain, because the bounded read destroyed the request
resolution: readBody reads through request.iterator with destroyOnReturn false, so the drain discards the rest; a raw chunked sender of 8 MiB over the limit failed 5 of 5 runs before and now reads the whole 413.

title: At a drain bound the input kept flowing and the close waited for the output, so a client could hold the connection
resolution: A bound now pauses the request and destroys the socket; the deadline runs until the socket closes, also after a normal body end with output unsent; unit and wire tests cover both bounds and input after them.

title: Drains after an early answer had no admission bound outside the webhook slots
resolution: BodyDrains admits at most MAX_CONCURRENT_DRAINS (16) and ends an answer at once beyond them, with no queue; tests cover saturation, release on close, and a valid delivery served while the only slot is held.

title: The early answer's promise was detached, so a write failure became an unhandled rejection
resolution: The answer path is synchronous, so a failing writeHead or write reaches the listener's destroy guard; a fault test, which failed before, shows the destroy and no unhandled rejection.

title: The bound tests did not establish each limit on the server and the time test did not show the connection open before the deadline
resolution: Unit tests check each bound one byte or millisecond below and at exhaustion, the wire tests check the server socket before and at the deadline and a byte window, and seven mutations of the bounds each failed a test; an early 401 test was added.

title: The raw socket tests could hang on a regression and left sockets open on failure
resolution: Every raw socket is kept and destroyed after each test, first-data waits reject on close or error, watchdogs use the real timers under mocked ones, and the servers close all connections; disabled drain completion failed in bounded time.

title: The early answer requirement covered every answer, promised receipt without bounds, and left the concurrency requirement unreconciled
resolution: The requirement names JSON, binary, and empty answers, separates the discard from the read, limits receipt to clients within both bounds, and states the forced close; a Bounded discards requirement and a MODIFIED receiver requirement follow, and contract section 5 matches.

title: The remaining gates listed passes 1 and 2 as unconditional
resolution: The gates state that pass 2 runs only after a Medium or worse pass 1, pass 3 only after a Medium or worse pass 2, and that the coordinator checks fixes that no later pass reviews.

title: An empty early answer was not written at once: a zero-length response.write left the head unsent until the body ended
resolution: BodyDrains.answer flushes the head of an empty answer and writes other content; a wire test with a stalled declared body on removeProjectMember reads the 204 head at once, and failed before with the connection closed at the deadline; a unit case checks the flush.

title: Bodiless requests answered on the synchronous path took a drain slot
resolution: serve treats a request with neither transfer-encoding nor a nonzero content-length as ended and answers it at once; a listener test checks no header and content-length 0 against content-length 5 and chunked, and failed before.

title: The scope line, the self-check, and the shouldKeepAlive citation named stale locations
resolution: The scope names body-drain.ts and the three test files with raw-sender.ts, the self-check places the bounds in body-drain.ts, and design.md and verification.md cite api-server.ts:133.

title: The byte bound counts decoded body bytes, not wire bytes
resolution: Contract section 5 and design A bound really stops state that the 32 MiB are body bytes without chunk framing and that the time bound limits the wire bytes; the spec delta already speaks of the discarded body and is unchanged.

title: The no-buffering test depends on a collector enabled at run time
resolution: The reviewer filed it as information only with no fix required: it passed 10 of 10 runs and in the review, and it passed every run of the pass 2 load series; the fallback the reviewer names applies if it ever flakes.

title: The contract wording implied that only early answers carry Connection: close
resolution: Section 5 says the early answer carries Connection: close like every answer.
